meta.name: document-gen-resilient-multiformat
meta.description: Resilient multi-format document generation with environment checks, auto-sanitization, and fallback engines

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成多格式文档，自动处理异常与降级
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要稳定生成多种格式的文档并自动处理错误
copy.tagline_en: Generate multi-format documents with auto-fallback and error handling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need reliable multi-format document generation with automatic error recovery

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按照分步工作流生成多格式文档（.docx、.pdf、.html），自动检查环境工具可用性，对PDF进行Unicode净化，并在主工具不可用时自动降级到Python备选引擎。
howto.when: 当需要从一份源内容生成多种格式文档，或者shell_agent返回未知错误，或者文档包含特殊字符，或者之前PDF生成因编码或依赖缺失失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这份Markdown生成DOCX和PDF，注意处理特殊字符。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow a step-by-step workflow to generate documents in multiple formats (.docx, .pdf, .html), performing pre-flight environment checks, automatically sanitizing Unicode for PDF output, and falling back to Python-based engines when primary tools are unavailable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when generating multiple output formats from a single source, when shell_agent returns unknown errors, when documents contain special characters, or when previous PDF generation failed due to encoding or missing dependencies.

say_en.text: Generate DOCX and PDF from this Markdown, handle special characters.
say_en.note: Full workflow with xelatex and Unicode sanitization.

say_en.text: Use Python fallback for PDF, don't use pandoc.
say_en.note: Skip pandoc, use fpdf2 or reportlab.

say_en.text: Generate HTML and DOCX only, skip PDF.
say_en.note: Omit PDF steps, convert to HTML and DOCX only.
